summary: Package manager mismatch: workspace: protocol incompatible with npm

evidence.error: npm error code EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL - Unsupported URL Type "workspace:": workspace:*

root_cause: Root package.json declares packageManager as npm@10.2.4, but 4 workspace dependencies use pnpm/yarn 'workspace:*' protocol which npm does not support

fix.strategy: Replace 'workspace:*' with '*' in all workspace package.json files

impact: Prevented npm install, blocking all subsequent quality gates

summary: Peer dependency conflict: React 19 incompatible with lucide-react@0.344.0
root_cause: Three example packages upgraded to React 19.x, but lucide-react@0.344.0 only supports React 16-18

fix.strategy: Option 1: Upgrade lucide-react to latest version (supports React 19), OR Option 2: Downgrade React to 18.x in affected packages

option_1.description: Update lucide-react to latest version in all packages

option_2.edits: Change react@^19.0.0 to react@^18.2.0 in 3 package.json files

root_cause: Outdated dependencies with known security vulnerabilities, primarily in Storybook v8.2.x packages

fix.strategy: Run npm audit fix and manually upgrade Storybook to latest stable version

impact: Security vulnerabilities exposed, potential exploitation risk

summary: Syntax error: Missing closing brace for while loop causing 'Unexpected catch'
root_cause: While loop starting at line 349 missing closing brace before return statement at line 466, causing catch block to appear orphaned

fix.strategy: Add closing brace after line 449 to close while loop
fix.patch: Add '}' after line 449 to close while(true) loop

impact: Blocked build of @clarity-chat/react and all 32 dependent packages

summary: Const reassignment error in token budget calculation

evidence.error: ERROR: Cannot assign to "remainingBudget" because it is a constant

root_cause: Variable 'remainingBudget' declared as const but needs to be mutated in loop

fix.patch_example:
- const remainingBudget = budget - essentialTokens
+ let remainingBudget = budget - essentialTokens
